'''Golden Age''' is a gameplay mechanic available to the [[Abbasid Dynasty]] and [[Ayyubids]] in ''[[Age of Empires IV]]''. It is a multi-tiered global bonus which unlocks new tiers depending on how many buildings are constructed within the [[House of Wisdom]] influence. The number of buildings that contribute towards the bonus, along with the tier of the bonus, are tracked in a widget on the UI. Once a tier is achieved, it can also be lost (reverted) if enough buildings are destroyed or deleted that the tier's requirements are no longer met. The Golden Age mechanic is the backbone of base building for the two civilizations and encourages players to always add new buildings in a manner that they can be connected to previous buildings.
== {{4icons|Abbasid Dynasty|36}} ==
{{#lsth:Abbasid Dynasty|Golden Age bonuses}}

The Abbasid Dynasty's Golden Age bonuses can be additionally improved by 50% by Aging up with the [[Administration Wing]].
